title: Thai Charred Cheese Satay
description: A twist on traditional satay, this Thai-inspired dish features charred cheese as the main protein, served with a side of spicy peanut sauce.
instructions: 2. Cut the charred cheese into skewers.
3. Brush the cheese with vegetable oil and season with tagine spice blend.
4. Grill the cheese for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
5. Meanwhile, heat yummy sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.
6. Add peanuts to the saucepan and stir until coated in sauce.
7. Serve grilled cheese with peanut sauce and garnish with garlic.
9. Optional: serve with a side of steamed vegetables or a simple salad.
10. Optional: add a sprinkle of malaysian chili flakes for extra heat.
